prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE newly rendered premium tactile metal game figurine on genuinely transparent RGBA background, 2:3 portrait full-body. Image1 is immutable original grade identity; image2 is the approved WR pilot material/light style. Preserve image1's distinctive wire-based structure, face inside open ring/cage, spiral emblem, grade-specific surface and components, in a slightly refreshed pose. Render polished and brushed metal with warm workshop light on subject and subtle cool rim. Wire coils/strands must remain evident; never turn into sheet-metal armor, vest or helmet humanoid. Keep full head/hands/feet and tool within canvas, character about 82% height with generous margins. No background, floor, shadow outside subject, pedestal, text, numbers, letters, logo, UI, card frame, watermark. Transparent gaps between wire. Spring steel: green-grey metallic open helical spring cage around cheerful spherical face with bright black oval eyes and joyful small open smile. Open coil spring torso, coiled spring arms and legs, brass spiral badge, spherical bead hands, simple open loop feet. A buoyant angled pose with one hand raised and both feet visible, original large spring cone head taper and gaps preserved.
